Write the Feasibility verdict as a short paragraph signed "(architect, 2026-09-03)" replacing the "Not yet." in "## Feasibility and usability" (leave room — the designer appends after you). Replace "Not yet." in "## Decomposition" with your attachment. Follow the precedent in initiatives/init-skills-availability.md for tone and length. Do NOT touch sections 1–3 or the Document History. Keep the whole initiative under 500 words outside the Document History. Edit the file with sed/heredoc/python via Bash. Report back the two paragraphs you wrote, verbatim.

  decomposition — which Bounded Context owns a capability; integration
  strategy and each contract's relationship kind; the product's
  non-functional requirements.
- *Recommends:* enabler work — technical work that makes features
  possible — into the PO's backlog.
- *Escalates to the authority:* a design that cannot satisfy an
  architecture principle — the role never grants itself an exception;
  contract-breaking changes; cross-context conflicts; any stack
  decision that commits the product
  to a vendor or a recurring cost above the threshold the authority
  sets when it approves this role — until set, every such commitment
  escalates.
- *Bounds, never approves:* Bounded Context shops choose within the
  guardrails; a choice outside them is raised as a contract question,
  not vetoed.

authoritative for what is specified and assigned; the scenario

findings, forward-looking prose, and code reachable only by entering
a Bounded Context.

decomposition; Bounded Context shops — messages of a

authority — escalations. Clarify questions on structure, stack,
contracts, and decomposition are answered by this role.

the harness loads skills from — by checking what stands there against

activity operates from the approved definition of that activity:
placement at the load point is what makes the skill load, and a clean
check is the shop's evidence that every approved process is available.

**Guiding statement:** A rendering is never the source of truth.
Whatever stands at the load point that a fresh render of an approved
definition would not put there is a finding, and every finding
resolves toward the definition — a re-render, a removal, or the
owner's decision on the definition — never an edit to a skill.

  load point, byte-equal to a fresh render of that definition —
